items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: bands like Renee and Chris, I mean our leaders like Renee and Chris

ctx.x: We were talking about those brass bands. You were saying Chris would get together, some of those guys?

Well yeah, bands like Renee and Chris, I mean our leaders like Renee and Chris, well they'd get a band, well then they would play this rough stuff like we do today, going and coming back to him to go to pick up the body, and what we call put them in the alley coming back. Put them in the alley? What does that mean? It's the blues. You know what I mean. I know what you mean.
